claim: disrobe decompiles JVM bytecode to Java that recompiles error-free under the real javac, per method, across the EdgeCases corpus.
detail: CI floor 131 of 131 (every top-level method recompiles error-free) measured under real javac attribution; the pickWord switch-expression lift (9afa2306) unmasked 25 latent defects previously hidden by javac parse-masking from the __unresolved__ token, all fixed by class: pattern-switch subject resolved to its source parameter (sealed-subtype exhaustiveness), sealed/permits emitted on inner type stubs, typed default initializers on final inner-stub fields, the Exceptions attribute threaded into a real throws clause, the loop-exhausted terminal emitted after a while loop whose exit is a shared pure-return tail, loop-captured locals hoisted to a fresh final declaration, and the shared return tail of an instanceof if-else-if chain duplicated under a Region-tree fall-through analysis
gate_source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/decompile_recompile_rate.rs (report_per_method_javac_recompile asserts ok >= PER_METHOD_JAVAC_OK_FLOOR 131 of PER_METHOD_JAVAC_TOTAL 131); CI runs it via the test job with actions/setup-java (JDK 25); floor measured 2026-06-22 after fixing the pickWord-unmasked defects

oracle.external: real javac (JDK 25): recovered Java must recompile error-free per method
oracle.note: Oracle strength is recompile-only: the recovered source compiling is necessary but not sufficient for equivalence (a dropped branch can still compile). The .pyc gate is the stronger standard (recompile-equivalent). Upgrade to bytecode-equivalence is tracked for a later phase.

title: JVM classfile decompilation, per-method javac recompile
